properties.key_insight: Total global data center spend is projected to grow from $310,000mm in 2024e to $910,000mm in 2028e, driven predominantly by AI Workload Spend.

entities.name: Table T2 – Morgan Stanley Estimated Annual Capital Cost for Chips and Servers
entities.brief: Projected chips and servers capital cost globally from 2024e to 2028e
entities.description: Highlights steady growth in hardware investment, reflecting financing needs in data center infrastructure

properties.key_insight: Total capital cost for chips and servers is forecast to increase from $310bn in 2024e to $930bn in 2028e, with both AI-related and non-AI-related costs rising steadily.
